name: nougen-builds
description: Light-first contractor system. Navy carries trust, orange carries action, and the two are never asked to do each other's job.

provenance.observed: Brand and surface colors, radii, the three tinted shadows, the shared transition, font wiring, max-width and scroll offset, all measured from shipped CSS.
provenance.invented: Spacing ramp, type scale, weights, tracking, the focus ring, ink-on-fill tokens, the darkened accent-text step, and the darkened text-muted replacement.

openWork: The primary conversion control (.btn-cta) ships white on orange at 2.45 and fails both AA levels. --on-accent generalizes the fix the source already uses in .storm-banner.
The shipped --text-muted (#718096) misses AA body on both surfaces and covers most running prose on the site. Replaced here; original retained as --text-muted-legacy for large text.
The variable --font-outfit loads Space Grotesk, not Outfit. Name kept for compatibility with existing markup.
Light-only by design. The dark hero, CTA band and footer are inverted sections, not a dark theme.
